snippet.title: Azhar Erriad: Hamzaoui is Missing!  -  Official Final Trailer
snippet.description:
-When Rayane arrives at Azhar Erriad School, he’s approached by Maxoj, who tells him a student named Hamzaoui has gone missing and promises a reward if he’s found.

-As Rayane investigates, he meets strange students, completes bizarre tasks, and uncovers something far more dangerous than he ever expected...
